records.name: YPE Philly
records.summary: The Philadelphia chapter of a national network for young professionals in the energy industry. It is open to anyone interested in energy work in the Philadelphia area and nearby region, and it holds a monthly networking gathering.
records.what_you_do: Come to the monthly gathering on the second Wednesday, 6 to 8 pm, at City Tap House Logan Square. Sign up for the next one through the group's events page.

schedule.text: Monthly gathering on the second Wednesday, 6 to 8 pm, at City Tap House Logan Square

first_step.how: Go to the next monthly gathering on the second Wednesday, or sign up for it through the group's events page
first_step.basis: Open to anyone interested in the energy industry, with a sign up path for each event; no beginner program is described

records.notes: No dated items on the site. Status is probably_active because the site works and describes a recurring monthly gathering, with no dated evidence. Registration goes to an Eventbrite page (lead platform, not read). The Green Drinks link on the events page goes to Green Drinks International, which lists no separate Philadelphia chapter, so it is not a lead. Legal name on the IRS list: Young Professionals in Energy, Philadelphia. Footer copyright 2023 is not evidence. Batch address 1421 N Howard St is not on the site, so no location was written for the IRS address.

records.name: Bainbridge Community Health Systems
records.summary: A health nonprofit in Philadelphia that runs community workshops and youth programs, and invites residents to volunteer, take part, or give.
records.what_you_do: Ask about current workshops or youth programs and join one when it is running. The group has invited the public to volunteer, take part, or donate.

first_step.how: Email info@bainbridgehealth.org or call (215) 645-9900 to ask about current workshops, youth programs, or volunteer openings
first_step.basis: The site invites volunteers and participation, but it lists no current events, so the way in is unclear

records.notes: Newest dated item is 2023-10-25 ('New Workshop Series'); two other posts are dated 2023-02-23, so status is dormant. The homepage shows no upcoming events. The Frankford resource center announced in 2023 has no address or opening date on the site. Summary stays general because the posts are older than two years. IRS list address 4222 Tackawanna St (19124) is not on the site, so no location was written. Footer copyright 2023 is not evidence.

records.name: Grief Speaks
records.summary: A virtual community for people working through grief and loss. It offers support groups, prayer calls, workshops and seminars, and one on one counseling or referrals.

first_step.basis: The site names support groups and prayer calls but publishes no dates or times, so the way in is unclear

records.name: JSJ Food Bank
records.summary: A nonprofit that offers free meals and behavioral health programs for students in grades K to 12 and adults 55 and older in Philadelphia.
records.what_you_do: Students and older adults can ask about free meals and behavioral health programs. The group also lists free after school programs.

cost.text: No cost, as the group describes its meals and programs

first_step.how: Call 215-375-4558 or email info@jsjfoodbank.org to ask how to get meals or sign up for the after school programs
first_step.basis: The site lists the services but no sign up steps, dates or hours, so the way in is unclear

records.notes: The homepage says 'Updates coming soon!' and has no dated items. The blog link leads to a staff page with no posts. The Instagram handle has no link, so it is not recorded. Food pantry is the closest interest tag: the group serves meals.

records.name: Pennsylvania Alliance of Recovery Residences
records.summary: A statewide alliance based in Philadelphia that certifies recovery houses to national standards, publishes a directory of certified houses, and offers education, advocacy and scholarships for people in recovery.
records.what_you_do: Look up a certified recovery house in the directory, or apply for a recovery house scholarship. Recovery house operators can apply for membership.

first_step.how: Search the recovery house directory on the group's site, or email f.way@parronline.org to ask about membership or scholarships
first_step.basis: The directory and scholarship notices are public, but membership needs an application

records.notes: Homepage shows 'Statewide Recovery House Scholarships available in 2026' with no month, and a 'Save the Date' for a NARR summit with no date. Any 2026 date is within the last 12 months, so status is active, but no month is shown, so last_sign_of_life is left out. The news page at /news returned 404 and was not read. The footer year 2015 is not evidence. The Bridge Foundation, named as the scholarship source, has no link and was not checked.

records.name: Project Always Receiving
records.summary: A Philadelphia group that works on vacant lots to create shared community space, and runs family events such as a back to school giveaway, a health and wellness fair and open mic nights.
records.what_you_do: Come to the open events, such as the back to school giveaway or the open mic night. Volunteers can use the volunteer form on the group's site.

schedule.text: Events come up through the year. Past ones include a back to school giveaway and a health and wellness fair in August, and an open mic night in May.

locations.label: Boys and Girls Club, Kinsey Street (giveaway venue)

first_step.how: Watch the events page for the next event and come by, or fill out the volunteer form on the group's site
first_step.basis: Events are open to the public, and the site has a volunteer form and a contact email

records.notes: Events page shows no upcoming events and three past ones: back to school giveaway 2025-08-30, health and wellness fair 2025-08-11, open mic 2025-05-24. Newest is August 2025, so probably_active, not active. Founded 2022 per the homepage; the footer year 2026 is not evidence. Batch name was spelled Receving; the site spells it Receiving. IRS list address 1347 Sellers Street is not on the site, so no group address was written. The volunteer form link was not fetched.

records.name: 901 Education
records.summary: A nonprofit that brings schools and local employers together so students in grades 6 to 12 can build job and college readiness through real community projects with professional partners.
records.what_you_do: Schools and businesses can take part in student projects and professional networking events. Professionals who want to help can ask the group how to get involved.

first_step.how: Use the contact page to ask how your school or business can join a student project
first_step.basis: Programs run through partner schools and sponsors, and the site does not explain how new schools or volunteers join

records.notes: Newest dated item is a post dated 2025-05-21 (8th grade entrepreneurship showcase at Thomas Jefferson University East Falls), so probably_active. The Welcome Kits project with Ronald McDonald House Charities of Philadelphia is undated. Sponsors named on the programs page were not recorded as leads. The /events page returned 404; the Events link goes to /projects-7, which was read. IRS list address 8611 Thomas Mill Ter is not on the site, so no location was written.

records.name: Andrée Collective
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that uses weddings and celebrations to offer jobs and counseling referrals to women who survived intimate partner violence or human trafficking. Supporters can give monthly or attend its annual gala.
records.what_you_do: Buy a ticket to the Celebrations for Freedom Gala, join the monthly Party 29 giving program, or apply through the group's Opportunities page for its board, its Emerging Leaders Council (ages 18 to 35), or an unpaid part time marketing internship.

schedule.text: An annual gala (the 2025 gala was on Sunday, November 2). Other events are listed on the upcoming events page.

cost.text: Gala tickets start at $125 for the 2026 event (early bird pricing)

first_step.how: Buy a ticket to the 2026 Celebrations for Freedom Gala at The Arts Ballroom, or click I'm Interested on the Opportunities page
first_step.basis: Galas and events are open to the public for purchase; board and council roles need an interest form

records.notes: Newest month level date is the 2025 gala on Sunday, November 2, 2025, so last_sign_of_life is 2025-11. The gala page gives only the year 2026 for the next gala and says early bird tickets are on sale, so the group is current. Awards in 2024 and 2025 on the homepage are not events and were not used for status. The marketing internship contact email is on the Opportunities page and is left out of contacts. Batch name had no accent; the site spells it with one.

records.name: ArtistYear
records.summary: A national AmeriCorps program that places full time teaching artists in K to 12 schools and community settings, including in Philadelphia.
records.what_you_do: Apply to serve as a full time ArtistYear Fellow teaching in schools or communities for 6 or 10 months. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the slots are filled.

schedule.text: Full time service: 10 months from a September start, or 6 months from a January start

first_step.how: Check the eligibility rules on the Apply Now page, then submit the application for the 2026 to 2027 program year
first_step.basis: Needs an application, an arts degree or comparable experience, U.S. citizenship or legal residency, and background checks

records.notes: The apply page names the 2026 to 2027 program year, the only dated evidence, so status is active with no month, and last_sign_of_life is left out. The homepage has no dated news. Philadelphia is listed as a service site on the contact page. The legal address 4431 Main St, Philadelphia 19127 matches the IRS list but is a mailing address, so no location was written. Pay is not stated. Closest interest tag is tutoring because no arts teaching tag fits. The contact email on the page is for school partnerships, so it is left out.

notes: Verdicts: 15 publish, 0 hide. Two searches were used, both on IRS groups White Dove and Yes We Care Recovery, and neither found a web presence. Searches ran out before We Reign, Christian Credit Development, House of Win and Lytle Love Foundation; their records are held back as unknown (no summary, categories or interests) and need a second pass with search budget. Grief Speaks has a summary but unknown status. No hide verdicts: none of the groups showed a signal that could be established as private, defunct or out of scope with the evidence available. Dropped: Green Drinks Philly (the listing points to YPE's Eventbrite page, no separate chapter found). Dead pages (404): parronline.org/news, andreecollective.org/events, 901education.org/events. Facebook pages (House of Win, Project Always Receiving) were recorded as social links and not read. Copyright years were not used as evidence. No rate limiting; one site failed on TLS every time. Fetches used: 37, including 404 responses and errors.
